This campus ranks second by published megawatts in the state, because its published megawatts is zero, placing it below the single facility that disclosed capacity and above the unmeasured majority. The state total of published capacity is 3 MW across all mapped facilities, indicating that nearly all New York data center infrastructure operates without public disclosure of scale.
